description: List past and running checks for the API key's workspace, newest first, optionally for one app. Each has its id (pass it to get_check for the full report and fix), app_id, client_label, repo, status, trigger (schedule, api, manual), created/finished times and the tables found leaking. Use it to see an app's history or whether a leak came back. Needs X-API-Key.

app_id.description: Optional: only this app's checks (an id from list_apps)

name: list_checks
title: List past checks
